subject: Performance evidence bundle & close timeline — Redwood evaluation MAP
messages:
From: James Park <james.park@fastretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood evaluation — perf targets and MAP

Hi Marissa / Rafael,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. FastRetail's platform team liked the latency profile but we need concrete, reproducible evidence for our procurement and platform teams before we move to legal. Specifically:

- End-to-end median latency (TTFT) for our sample documents at 1k tokens and 3k tokens
- Sustained throughput with concurrency levels of 8, 32, and 128
- 95th percentile latency under typical burst patterns (15s bursts)

Can you bundle these into something we can attach to the MAP? Prefer: CSV exports of raw runs, a short slide deck executive readout, and a dashboard link that our SREs can poke at.

Target close: we want to complete technical eval and sign SOW by 2026-02-21. Let me know if that timeline is realistic.

Thanks,
James Park
Director, Platform Engineering
FastRetail

Attachment: sample-slo-and-inputs.json (sent earlier)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: James Park <james.park@fastretail.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood evaluation — perf targets and MAP

James — thanks for the clear ask. We can deliver exactly that and will package it for your MAP so procurement and SREs have everything they need. Proposed plan and deliverables: 

1) Evidence bundle (by 2026-02-14):
   - Raw CSV of benchmark runs (latency/throughput/TTFT per run)
   - Executive slides (3–5 slides) summarizing SLOs, test harness, and top-line numbers
   - Live dashboard link + temporary read-only credentials for your SREs

2) Acceptance / review window (2026-02-15 to 2026-02-18): FastRetail reviews materials and requests two follow-up test runs if needed.

3) Final readout & sign-off call (2026-02-19): 30-minute exec readout with our Solutions Engineering + your platform lead.

4) Target SOW signature (2026-02-21) — matches your date.

Rafael will run the benchmark harness with your inputs and I'll assemble the slides and dashboard. Can you confirm which data center region we should run in (us-west-2 or us-east-1) and whether we should include a quantized model run in the baseline?

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0187

Attachment: draft-evidence-checklist.md

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, James Park <james.park@fastretail.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 14:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood evaluation — perf targets and MAP

On Wed, Feb 11, 2026 at 09:07 Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com> wrote:
> James — thanks for the clear ask. We can deliver exactly that and will package it for your MAP so procurement and SREs have everything they need. Proposed plan and deliverables:
>
> 1) Evidence bundle (by 2026-02-14):

James / team — quick technical update from the benchmark run side. Summary:

- Test harness: Redwood bench v2 with your sample prompts (provided on 2026-02-09). We ran 3 waveforms: steady, burst (15s every 2m), and ramp.
- Hardware: Dedicated c6i.12x-large inference instances in us-west-2 (GPU-backed) — pinned to same model binary across runs.
- Models/configs: roomy-base (fp16), roomy-quant (8-bit), and roomy-quant-hybrid (mixed).

Top-line numbers (median / 95th / throughput) for 1k-token trace, concurrency 32 (steady):
- roomy-base (fp16): median TTFT 180 ms, 95th 520 ms, sustained throughput ~420 tokens/s per instance
- roomy-quant (8-bit): median TTFT 210 ms, 95th 760 ms, sustained throughput ~480 tokens/s per instance
- roomy-quant-hybrid: median TTFT 195 ms, 95th 610 ms, sustained throughput ~460 tokens/s per instance

Concurrency sweep highlights (peak sustainable qps across cluster of 4 instances):
- concurrency 8: 1.1k tokens/s
- concurrency 32: 4.2k tokens/s
- concurrency 128: 9.6k tokens/s (95th latency climbs toward 1.2s under burst)

What I'm attaching:
- fr-redwood-benchmark-raw.csv (per-request latencies + run metadata)
- perf-dashboard-link.txt (contains temporary read-only dashboard URL and creds)
- short notes that explain how to reproduce the run locally (bench-harness commands)

I'll hand off the CSV and dashboard link to Marissa for slide assembly and MAP packaging. If FastRetail wants an extra run in us-east-1 or with a larger model, we'll schedule for next week but that may shift the close by a few days.

Rafael Mendes
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.com

Attachments: fr-redwood-benchmark-raw.csv, perf-dashboard-link.txt

From: Cora Lin <cora.lin@fastretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: James Park <james.park@fastretail.com>, FastRetail Purchasing <purchasing@fastretail.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood evaluation — perf targets and MAP

Thanks all — looks good and thanks for the quick turnaround. A few requests to finalize the MAP: 

- Please add a one-page executive readout slide that states: "Key result: median TTFT <= 220 ms (1k tokens) across our baseline configs; 95th <= 800 ms for steady load." That will go to our procurement packet.
- We need the raw CSV and the dashboard link included as attachments in the MAP (PDF-friendly).
- Please include an explicit line in the MAP that lists the test region (us-west-2) and the model revision used (roomy-base v2026-02-09-rt).
- Can you also add a short note (1–2 bullets) about scaling behavior under concurrency 128 and the fallback policy Redwood will apply if 95th > 1s during production bursts?

If you can get the slides and packaged zip to me by EOD Monday (2026-02-16) we'll keep our procurement review on schedule and remain on target for the 2026-02-21 SOW signature.

Cora Lin
Senior Procurement Manager | FastRetail
